capabilities: Sync encrypted notes and attachments over WebDAV
Create a vault and join it by QR code
Merge concurrent Markdown and text edits
extras: Requires a WebDAV server supporting GET, PUT, PROPFIND, MKCOL and same-origin MOVE; losing the last vault key makes remote data unrecoverable. The server can see folder names, object sizes, counts and access times.
problem: Users who want to keep Obsidian notes on their own WebDAV server lack an encrypted, per-vault sync option.
summary: Encrypted sync plugin that stores each vault in its own WebDAV folder with a separate key.
